app-and-request-context-management.title: App and Request Context Management
app-and-request-context-management.capability: Defines application and request contexts, the g namespace and context helpers that bind per-app and per-request state, URL matching and session opening.

application-logging-setup.title: Application Logging Setup
application-logging-setup.capability: Creates and configures the application's logger and default handler, writing to the WSGI error stream with a standard format.

blueprint-deferred-registration.title: Blueprint Deferred Registration
blueprint-deferred-registration.capability: Implements the sansio Blueprint, which records routes and callbacks as deferred functions and applies them, including app-wide Jinja and handler registrations, when registered on an app.

cli-app-import-and-discovery.title: CLI App Import and Discovery
cli-app-import-and-discovery.capability: Imports modules and resolves application objects by name, attribute or factory string, searching a module for the Flask app when unnamed.

cli-groups-and-built-in-commands.title: CLI Groups and Built-in Commands
cli-groups-and-built-in-commands.capability: Defines the app-context-aware Click groups, the top-level flask group, its entry point, and the routes and shell commands.

cli-options-and-app-loading-info.title: CLI Options and App Loading Info
cli-options-and-app-loading-info.capability: Supports the command line with Click parameter types, option callbacks, dotenv loading and the ScriptInfo object that tracks how to find the app.

cli-run-command-and-command-discovery.title: CLI Run Command and Command Discovery
cli-run-command-and-command-discovery.capability: Runs the development server command and discovers commands from plugins and the user's app, loading and caching the application.

command-line-and-public-helpers.title: Command Line and Public Helpers
command-line-and-public-helpers.capability: Provides the user-facing command line interface together with public helper functions, the WSGI-aware Blueprint and the app run method that developers call directly.

configuration-loading.title: Configuration Loading
configuration-loading.capability: Implements the Config dict and its loaders from Python files, objects, mappings, data files and environment variables, plus a config-backed attribute descriptor.

exception-handler-lookup-and-dispatch.title: Exception Handler Lookup and Dispatch
exception-handler-lookup-and-dispatch.capability: Finds registered error handlers and decides how HTTP and other exceptions raised during dispatch are handled, trapped or re-raised.

flask-app-class-and-utilities.title: Flask App Class and Utilities
flask-app-class-and-utilities.capability: Defines the concrete Flask WSGI application class and its supporting facilities for Jinja setup, teardown, file access, shell context, and test client and runner creation.

flask-app-request-lifecycle.title: Flask App Request Lifecycle
flask-app-request-lifecycle.capability: Implements the concrete Flask application and its request lifecycle: WSGI entry, dispatch, response finalization and exception handling, grouped as the app's per-request pipeline.

flask-cli-implementation.title: Flask CLI Implementation
flask-cli-implementation.capability: Implements the flask command line: parameter types, app loading and import discovery, the command groups, built-in commands and the development server command.

flask-web-framework.title: Flask Web Framework
flask-web-framework.capability: Implements the Flask WSGI micro-framework: application core, request handling, contexts, CLI, templating, sessions, JSON and configuration support, and testing tools.

helpers-flask-blueprint-and-run.title: Helpers, Flask Blueprint and Run
helpers-flask-blueprint-and-run.capability: Gathers public helper functions (url_for, redirect, flash, send_file, abort, debug flags), the WSGI-aware Blueprint, and the app's run method.

json-providers-and-helpers.title: JSON Providers and Helpers
json-providers-and-helpers.capability: Defines the pluggable JSON provider interface, its default implementation, and module-level dumps, loads and jsonify functions that use the current app's provider.

request-dispatch-cycle.title: Request Dispatch Cycle
request-dispatch-cycle.capability: Runs the per-request cycle: preprocessing, dispatching to the view function, default OPTIONS response and routing exception handling.

response-finalization-and-error-fallback.title: Response Finalization and Error Fallback
response-finalization-and-error-fallback.capability: Turns view return values into responses, runs post-processing and session saving, and handles unhandled exceptions, with sync wrappers for async views.

runtime-app-contexts-and-testing.title: Runtime App, Contexts and Testing
runtime-app-contexts-and-testing.capability: Covers the running application: the concrete Flask app and request lifecycle, the contexts that bind per-request state, and the tools for testing apps.

sansio-app-and-scaffold-foundations.title: Sansio App and Scaffold Foundations
sansio-app-and-scaffold-foundations.capability: Provides the framework-agnostic foundations that the concrete Flask app and blueprints build on: shared scaffold registration, blueprint recording, app base setup and logging.

sansio-app-base-and-logging.title: Sansio App Base and Logging
sansio-app-base-and-logging.capability: Defines the framework-agnostic application base class and the logger setup it uses, covering app construction, configuration and Jinja environment preparation.

sansio-app-base-class.title: Sansio App Base Class
sansio-app-base-class.capability: Defines the framework-agnostic App base class: construction, config and Jinja environment setup, template registrations, URL building support and teardown or shell registrations.

scaffold-and-blueprint-registration.title: Scaffold and Blueprint Registration
scaffold-and-blueprint-registration.capability: Defines how routes, handlers and callbacks are declared and deferred, through the shared Scaffold base and the sansio Blueprint that builds on it.

scaffold-base-and-setup-decorators.title: Scaffold Base and Setup Decorators
scaffold-base-and-setup-decorators.capability: Provides the Scaffold base class shared by apps and blueprints, with route, error handler and callback registration decorators plus static folder and path helpers.

session-interface-and-cookies.title: Session Interface and Cookies
session-interface-and-cookies.capability: Implements sessions: session classes, the abstract session interface and the default signed-cookie backend with cookie settings, expiry and save decisions.

tagged-json-serialization.title: Tagged JSON Serialization
tagged-json-serialization.capability: Implements TaggedJSONSerializer and its tag classes, which encode non-JSON types such as bytes, datetime, tuple and UUID into JSON-compatible structures and back.

template-rendering-and-loading.title: Template Rendering and Loading
template-rendering-and-loading.capability: Handles Jinja integration: the app-bound environment, a loader spanning app and blueprints, and render and stream functions with signals and context processors.

templates-views-and-wrappers.title: Templates, Views and Wrappers
templates-views-and-wrappers.capability: Groups the view-layer pieces: Jinja template rendering and loading with class-based views, request and response wrappers, signals and debugging aids.

test-client-and-cli-runner.title: Test Client and CLI Runner
test-client-and-cli-runner.capability: Offers testing tools: an environment builder with app defaults, a context-aware test client with session editing, and an app-aware CLI runner.

views-wrappers-signals-and-debug-aids.title: Views, Wrappers, Signals and Debug Aids
views-wrappers-signals-and-debug-aids.capability: Provides class-based views, request and response wrapper classes, signals, debug helper errors and template loading diagnostics, plus the python -m entry point.

wsgi-entry-and-request-contexts.title: WSGI Entry and Request Contexts
wsgi-entry-and-request-contexts.capability: Provides the WSGI entry points that create and push request contexts, dispatch, produce responses and always pop the context.
